He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Stanford Cardinal men's basketball|Stanford Cardinal]]. ==Early life and high school== Okorie is of Nigerian descent, raised in [[Nashua, New Hampshire]]. He attended [[Brewster Academy]] in [[Wolfeboro, New Hampshire]]. Initially, Okorie committed to play [[college basketball]] for the [[Harvard Crimson men's basketball|Harvard Crimson]].{{cite web |last1=Nelson |first1=Jack |title=Ebuka Okorie features maturity, poise for Brewster Academy at Hoophall Classic |url=https://www.masslive.com/hoophallclassic/2025/01/ebuka-okorie-features-maturity-poise-for-brewster-academy-at-hoophall-classic.html |website=MassLive.com |access-date=17 December 2025}} But after his [[Senior (education)|senior]] season where he was named the New Hampshire Boys Gatorade Player of the Year, he flipped his commitment to play for the [[Stanford Cardinal men's basketball|Stanford Cardinal]].{{cite web |last1=Hewitt |first1=Steve |title=Q&A: Ebuka Okorie on transition to Stanford, expectations for freshman season |url=https://www.basketballjournal.com/2025/10/06/qa-ebuka-okorie-on-transition-to-stanford-expectations-for-freshman-season/ |website=New England Basketball Journal |access-date=17 December 2025}} ==College career== Okorie entered his true [[freshman]] season as a starter for the Cardinal.{{cite web |last1=Kroichick |first1=Ron |title=Stanford's Ebuka Okorie flew under recruiting radars. Now he's a college hoops star |url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/sports/college/article/ebuka-okorie-basketball-stanford-21203985.php |website=San Francisco Chronicle |access-date=17 December 2025}} In his collegiate debut on November 4, 2025, he put up 26 points in a victory over [[2025–26 Portland State Vikings men's basketball team|Portland State]].{{cite web |title=Freshman Ebuka Okorie leads Stanford over Portland State 89-79 in season opener |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/freshman-ebuka-okorie-leads-stanford-over-portland-state-89-79-in-season-opener/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=3 January 2026}} On November 8, Okorie dropped 29 points in a win versus [[2025–26 Montana Grizzlies basketball team|Montana]].{{cite web |title=Okorie scores 29, Stanford pulls away from Montana for 91-68 win |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/okorie-scores-29-stanford-pulls-away-from-montana-for-91-68-win/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=3 January 2026}} On November 11, he recorded 21 points and three assists in a win over [[2025–26 Montana State Bobcats men's basketball team|Montana State]].{{cite web |last1=Sullivan |first1=Isaac |title=Freshman star leads comeback win over Montana State |url=https://stanforddaily.com/2025/11/13/freshman-star-leads-comeback-win/ |website=The Stanford Daily |access-date=3 January 2026}} On November 18, Okorie scored 26 points, while adding five assists in a victory against [[2025–26 Louisiana Ragin' Cajuns men's basketball team|Louisiana]].{{cite web |last1=Grausz |first1=Dylan |title=Stanford Freshman Looking Like a Top NBA Draft Pick |url=https://www.si.com/college/stanford/basketball/stanford-freshman-looking-like-a-top-nba-draft-pick |work=Stanford Cardinal on SI |publisher=SI.com |access-date=18 December 2025}} On November 27, he dropped 25 points in a win against [[2025–26 Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball team|Minnesota]].{{cite web |title=Ebuka Okorie scores 25, Stanford beats Minnesota 72-68 at Acrisure Invitational |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/ebuka-okorie-scores-25-stanford-050258741.html |website=Yahoo Sports |access-date=3 January 2026}} In December 20, Okorie set the Cardinal single-game record for most points scored by a [[freshman]] with 32 in a victory over [[2025–26 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Colorado]].{{cite web |title=Local colleges: Ebuka Okorie scores 32 points in return as Stanford tops Colorado |url=https://www.sfchronicle.com/sports/college/article/ebuka-okorie-scores-32-points-return-lead-21254393.php |website=San Francisco Chronicle |access-date=3 January 2026}} On December 27, he dropped 30 points in a win versus [[2025–26 Cal State Northridge Matadors men's basketball team|Cal State Northridge]].{{cite web |last1=Salerno |first1=Cameron |title=Ranking college basketball's best freshmen: Stanford's Ebuka Okorie earns Freshman of the Week honors |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/ranking-college-basketballs-best-freshmen-stanfords-ebuka-okorie-earns-freshman-of-the-week-honors/ |website=CBS Sports |access-date=3 January 2026}} On January 7, 2026, Okorie dropped 31 points and six assists, including the game-winning three in a victory over [[2025–26 Virginia Tech Hokies men's basketball team|Virginia Tech]].{{cite web |last1=Sullivan |first1=Isaac |title=Okorie leads late-game magic as Stanford men’s basketball steals win over Hokies |url=https://stanforddaily.com/2026/01/08/okorie-leads-rally-as-stanford-wins/ |website=The Stanford Daily |access-date=10 January 2026}} On January 16, he scored a career-high 36 points and nine assists in an upset victory over [[2025–26 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]].{{cite web |last1=Swanson |first1=Shelby |title=No. 14 UNC men’s basketball upset by Stanford, Ebuka Okorie on the road |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/unc/article314290259.html |website=Raleigh News & Observer |access-date=17 January 2026}} Okorie led the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] in scoring with 23.2 points per game as well as 3.6 rebounds, 3.6 assists and 1.6 steals per game. He was a First Team All-ACC selection as well as being an honorable mention All-American. Following the season Okorie declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{cite news |title=Stanford star freshman Ebuka Okorie declares for NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/48440648/stanford-star-freshman-ebuka-okorie-declares-nba-draft |access-date=May 13, 2026 |work=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |date=April 9, 2026}} == References == {{reflist}} ==External links== *[https://gostanford.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/player/ebuka-okorie Stanford Cardinal bio] {{DEFAULTSORT:Okorie, Ebuka}} [[Category:2007 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from New Hampshire]] [[Category:Brewster Academy alumni]] [[Category:Point guards]] [[Category:Sportspeople from Nashua, New Hampshire]] [[Category:Stanford Cardinal men's basketball players]]
